Chapter 6902: You Can Have It

Chapter 6902: You Can Have It

Guangmai grew anxious since the world’s heart was so close.

“I will do it!” He melted into the portal to reach the other side.

His dark power manifested into a tsunami crashing into the sky.

“Buzz.” The overlords lost control of their bodies since Guangmai had taken over without using his real body.

His divine intent reached Golden Lamp and became one with them. Their eyes lit up just like his - a pure light that could be seen at the start of the grand dao.

This was a heaven-defying method made more accessible due to the staff of authority. The combined beast rushed forward, landing next to the primordial tree.

Now, they were assaulted by both the illumination and the tree’s primordial power. Their heart devils immediately shattered. The light then wrapped around their dao hearts and ignited them.

“Noooo!” The fallen overlords understood this was it. A dao heart could fall but still had to be there. Igniting it was suicidal.

Guangmai, despite being in control, couldn’t stop the ignition. He also couldn’t move them now that their dao hearts were actively working against him.

“Damn!” Spectators became startled. Some realized why Golden Lamp was untouchable all these years.

“Return to me!” Guangmai’s divine intent shouted: “May the alliance’s glory light your souls!”

“Rumble!” His divine intent exploded and destroyed the overlords’ body, true fate, and grand dao.

They couldn’t let out one last scream since it was too late. The remnant essences then fused with darkness, forming a mass of flesh and blood. It wrapped around Guangmai’s divine intent and blocked the illumination.

Since the overlords were dead, Guangmai became the flesh ball’s new master. It landed next to Li Qiye, grew a pair of hands, and grabbed the world’s heart.

Spectators who were startled by the overlords’ death became ecstatic again.

“My world’s heart!” Guangmai had waited an eternity for this moment.

“Do you want it?” Li Qiye opened his eyes and smiled: “You can have it.”

He then pushed the world’s heart forward.

“Boom!” An indescribable power seemingly as old as the high heaven erupted, sending the flesh ball flying.

Large cracks appeared, allowing the illumination and primordial auras to ooze through.

“Ahh!” The divine intent received backlash from his dao heart’s, unable to linger in Golden Lamp.

The more he waited, the stronger his dao heart would become to fight the heart devil. Thus, his divine intent controlled the flesh ball back to the portal.

“Bam!” Guangmai flew out of the membrane and smashed the throne. The flesh ball was absorbed by the staff of authority.
